items.title: Humana (HUM) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Star Ratings And Q3 Beat
items.summary: The latest valuation work on Humana lifts the assessed fair value from US$465.13 to US$475.54, signaling a modest reset in price targets. Analysts linking this move to recent Q3 results and improved Medicare Advantage Star Ratings describe a generally constructive mood, even as some still flag policy and execution risks. Read on to see what is driving the shifting Humana story and how you can track the next turns in this narrative. Analyst Price Targets don't always capture the full story...

items.title: Medicare Just Locked In Most of Your 2027 Costs. One Big Number Is Still Missing
items.summary: Medicare open enrollment ends Dec. 7, and most 2027 costs are set: a $2,400 Part D cap, a $700 deductible and a 3.6% COLA. For a 72-year-old with one costly drug, the bill rises $300, her check nets about $76 more a month, and a plan comparison is worth $408.
